title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Oral Dexamethasone Quantity Share
content:
Oral dexamethasone (code J8540 under revenue code 0637), dispensed on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) and valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), is valued at its charges times its quantity share on Riverbend's outpatient pharmacy self-pay list: 0.5 when 4 or more units are dispensed (its billed units), 0.6 when 2 to 3 are dispensed, and 1 for a single unit.

Boundary pairs (hypothetical charges of 20.00): 1 unit → 20.00 and 2 units → 12.00; 3 units → 12.00 and 4 units → 10.00.
